# JSArt&Decor — Handcrafted Textiles, Luxury Bedsheets & Art Decor

> Official AI & LLM Machine-Readable Index and Knowledge Context for JSArt&Decor (Jaipur, India).
> Manufacturer, Wholesaler (B2B), and Retailer (B2C) of authentic pure cotton Jaipur handblock print bedsheets, hospitality linens, and artisanal home decor.

## Core Corporate & Brand Identity

- **Brand Name**: JSArt&Decor
- **Legal Entity**: JSArt&Decor Handcrafted Textiles & Art Decor Private Limited
- **Base Headquarters**: Phase II Industrial Estate, Jaipur, Rajasthan 302022, India
- **Primary Website**: https://jsartanddecor.com
- **Contact Support**: +91 86024 14046 / info.jsartanddecor@gmail.com
- **Business Model**: Hybrid D2C Retail & B2B Wholesale (Hospitality, Hotel Chains, Event Planners, Interior Designers, Export)
- **Primary Craft**: 100% Pure Combed Long-Staple Cotton, Authentic Bagru & Sanganeri Teak Hand-Block Printing, Mercerized Hotel Bedding, Brass and Terracotta Art Decor

## All Store Pages & Functional Routes

### 1. Home Page
- **URL**: https://jsartanddecor.com/
- **Purpose**: Showcase brand heritage, featured artisan block prints, video showcase, customer reviews, dynamic banners, and key collections.
- **Key Offerings**: 100% pure cotton certification, artisanal block print showcase, factory direct manufacturing, quick B2B quotes.

### 2. Product Catalog (Retail & Wholesale)
- **URL**: https://jsartanddecor.com/?view=catalog
- **Purpose**: Interactive search, filter, and sorting for all products.
- **Filter Pipelines**:
  - **Production Type**: Handmade (Artisan handblock) vs. Factory (Precision loom weaving).
  - **Segments**: Home, Hotel, Event.
  - **Product Types**: HOME DECOR, ART DECOR, ELECTRIC DECOR.
  - **Pricing Modes**: Retail (individual sets) & Wholesale (MOQ tiered volume pricing).

### 3. B2B Wholesale Category Tree
- **URL**: https://jsartanddecor.com/?view=wholesale-tree
- **Purpose**: Structured B2B wholesale matrix allowing bulk procurement managers to navigate by production pipeline, industry segment, and tiered Minimum Order Quantities (MOQ).
- **MOQ Range**: Starts at 4 to 20 pieces per SKU with up to 40% bulk discount from retail MSRP.

### 4. Blog & Textile Research Knowledge Hub
- **URL**: https://jsartanddecor.com/?view=blogs
- **Purpose**: Expert educational articles and maintenance guides regarding Indian textiles, thread count science, handblock printing history, and commercial hospitality decoration.

### 5. Corporate & Hospitality Partners
- **URL**: https://jsartanddecor.com/?view=partners
- **Purpose**: Verified portfolio of hospitality chains, luxury resorts, boutique homestays, and wedding event managers sourcing from JSArt&Decor.

### 6. Contact Us & B2B Inquiry Desk

### 8. Shopping Cart & Checkout

## All Published Articles & Knowledge Guides

### Article 1: The Evolution of Thread Count: What Hotels Look for in Commercial Bedsheets
- **URL**: https://jsartanddecor.com/?blog=1
- **Category**: Textile Technology & Hospitality
- **Author**: JSArt&Decor Textile Research
- **Summary**: Demystifies the misconception that higher thread count (TC) always equals higher quality. Explains why 300–400 TC crafted with 100% single-ply long-staple combed cotton outperforms 1000 TC synthetic microfiber in breathability, anti-pilling durability, and 200+ commercial wash cycle resistance.
- **Key Concepts**: Extra-Long Staple (ELS) Cotton, Single-Ply vs Multi-Ply Yarns, Mercerization Process, Sateen & Percale Weaves, Hotel Laundering Standards.

### Article 2: Preserving Traditional Jaipur Hand-Block Printing in Modern Interior Decor
- **URL**: https://jsartanddecor.com/?blog=2
- **Category**: Handmade Products & Heritage Crafts
- **Author**: Chief Designer, JSArt&Decor
- **Summary**: Details the centuries-old artisanal block-printing heritage of Sanganer and Bagru (Rajasthan). Explains teak wood block carving, natural plant and mineral dyes, organic imperfections that give handmade textiles their unique charm, and ethical fair-trade artisan support.
- **Key Concepts**: Teak Wood Hand Blocks, Azo-Free and Vegetable Dyes, Sustainable Water Treatment, Authentic Bagru Motifs, Washing & Preserving Hand-Printed Fabrics.

### Article 3: 5 Statement Art & Decor Trends Transforming Hotel Lobbies and Banquet Events
- **URL**: https://jsartanddecor.com/?blog=3
- **Category**: Industry Updates & Commercial Decor
- **Author**: Event Style Team
- **Summary**: Analyzes shifting trends in hotel banquet halls, reception lobbies, and luxury weddings toward sustainable reusable brass sculptures, embroidered velvet table runners, and terracotta botanical accents.
- **Key Concepts**: Solid Brass & Terracotta Combinations, Zari & Zardozi Velvet Embroidery, Acoustic Wall Hangings, Ambient Lighting Sconces, Modular Event Staging.
